## Change

What direction, scope, assumption, or outcome changes? Explain the consequence for the initiative.

## Basis

Link the evidence and decision. Separate observations from interpretation. State limitations.

## Documents and delivery

- [ ] Current brief reflects the candidate direction.
- [ ] Decision names any earlier direction it replaces.
- [ ] Changelog records the meaningful change.
- [ ] Linked tracker task describes any follow-up; execution status is not copied into docs.
- [ ] The proposal is distinguishable from the accepted state and from shipped functionality.

## Verification

Record actual link checks and reader checks. Do not present synthetic research as validation.

## Review

Name the decision requiring human approval and any questions that remain open.
